description: This file defines an abstract class 'InputConnectionsProvider' that provides an interface for accessing input device connections via file descriptors in a virtual machine environment. It includes methods to retrieve connections for rotary devices, mouse, keyboard, switches, touchscreen, and touchpad devices.

classes.name: InputConnectionsProvider
classes.description: An abstract class providing access to input device connection file descriptors, including methods for rotary device, mouse, keyboard, switches, touchscreen, and touchpad connections.

methods.name: RotaryDeviceConnection
methods.description: Returns the file descriptor for the rotary device connection.

methods.name: MouseConnection
methods.description: Returns the file descriptor for the mouse connection.

methods.name: KeyboardConnection
methods.description: Returns the file descriptor for the keyboard connection.

methods.name: SwitchesConnection
methods.description: Returns the file descriptor for the switches connection.

methods.name: TouchscreenConnections
methods.description: Returns a vector of file descriptors for touchscreen connections.

methods.name: TouchpadConnections
methods.description: Returns a vector of file descriptors for touchpad connections.
